definitions.basis: EMA span 60s (alpha=2/61) of gap at whole seconds < floor(t); restart after data hole > 2 s; warm-up 60 s
definitions.trade: enter HL at t+L book (ask if dgap>0, bid if <0), exit at book at t+L+3s crossing spread

sets.event_db: every Binance update time, 3 s debounce (non-overlapping)

fills.local: HL book received by t+L (simulator convention)
fills.engine_asof: HL book with exchange ts <= t+L (needs clock sync)
fills.engine_next: first HL book with exchange ts >= t+L (pessimistic)

views.recv: signal uses HL book received by t (causal)
views.engine: signal uses HL book with exchange ts <= t (emulated zero-delay HL feed)

definitions.fresh: a quote or fill book older than 2 s invalidates the decision/trade
